title: Sloth with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='10' y='72' width='80' height='10' rx='5' fill='#a0703a'/>
  <rect x='10' y='72' width='80' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c0904f'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#b0804a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#c99a63'/>
  <!-- arms holding branch -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='70' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#a0703a' transform='rotate(-15 28 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='70' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#a0703a' transform='rotate(15 72 70)'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='75' r='4' fill='#8a5c2a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='75' r='4' fill='#8a5c2a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#c99a63'/>
  <!-- face mask (lighter) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <!-- eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='36' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='36' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='35' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <!-- sparkle glints -->
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#aef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#aef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='37.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='37.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M44 31 l1 -2 l1 2 l-1 2 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M56 31 l1 -2 l1 2 l-1 2 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <!-- nose highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='42.3' rx='1.2' ry='0.7' fill='#9a7a5a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 46 Q50 50 55 46' stroke='#7a5a3a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='34' r='5' fill='#c99a63'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='34' r='5' fill='#c99a63'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <!-- little leaf on branch -->
  <path d='M85 70 Q92 60 88 52 Q82 58 85 70 Z' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <path d='M85 70 Q87 62 88 52' stroke='#388e3c' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
</svg>
